sections.changelog:
• 26.11.07: Migrated plugin updater directly to GitHub Releases for faster and seamless automated updates.
  • 26.11.02: Fixed PHP Warning "Cannot modify header information - headers already sent" in Security Headers module by verifying header status before removal. Added safety checks for security.txt generation.
  • 26.10.26: Added custom plugin icon and logo across the admin menu and plugins list page. Minor improvements and code refinements.
  • 26.10.22: Ensured comprehensive Admin Whitelisting: automatically trusts and auto-whitelists administrator IPs on login and dashboard activity, purges conflicting bans, and syncs trusted IPs to Cloudflare Access Rules.
  • Improved Cloudflare Smart Rate Limiting & Real-time Defense to automatically exempt logged-in users and admin-ajax.php, preventing DataTables Ajax errors and admin dashboard lockouts.
  • Added Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP), Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy (CORP), and X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies security headers.
  • Added Server & Technology Masking to prevent version leaks (strips X-Powered-By, X-Turbo-Charged-By, and Server headers via PHP and .htaccess).
  • Fixed Content-Security-Policy (CSP) escaping bug by stripping slashes before output and unslashing on save.
  • Improved Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) SSL detection behind reverse proxies and Cloudflare.
  • Updated Security Headers UI with configuration toggles and live status preview for all headers.
